# Master list of secret-exclusion patterns — the source of truth for every
# ignore file and deny rule in this repo. Syntax: gitignore-style, one pattern
# per line; blank lines and `#` comments are ignored.
#
# Edit this file, then run:
#   node .github/scripts/sync-ignores.mjs
# to regenerate every downstream file (ignore files, Claude deny rules, and
# the Copilot YAML). CI verifies they stay in sync via `--check`.
#
# Owned by the security team (see .github/CODEOWNERS).
